title.rendered: Press Release – Sherwood Education Association Schedules “Walk-in” Advocacy Event for May 8, 2019

content.rendered: On May 8, teachers at all Sherwood Schools locations will participate in a “walk-in” event, for the purpose of raising awareness of the need for increased education funding.  For more information, please see the attached press release.
